headline: Nimit Rajesh Ghatalia files substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Code for Aarey Drugs
sum: Nimit Rajesh Ghatalia has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE regarding substantial shareholding in Aarey Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Limited, triggering mandatory takeover-code compliance and marking the entry of a new promoter or significant investor into the pharmaceutical company.
detail: Nimit Rajesh Ghatalia submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under SEBI's Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers (SAST) Regulations, 2011, to the National Stock Exchange on or around 1 July 2026. Regulation 31(4) requires disclosure when a person acquires or agrees to acquire shares or voting rights such that the aggregate shareholding (including associates) reaches or exceeds 25% of total voting capital, or when a person (already holding 25%+) makes a further acquisition to increase shareholding by 2% or more in a 12-month period. The filing indicates either a new substantial stake entry or a material increase by an existing substantial shareholder in Aarey Drugs, a pharmaceutical company, and triggers mandatory open offer or exemption review under SEBI's takeover regime.
